description: This source file provides generic handlers for working with OVS_SET data structures, including functions for serialization to JSON and deserialization from JSON for various data types such as integers, booleans, real numbers, strings, and UUIDs. It is used for handling sets within OVS (Open vSwitch) configurations and state representations in JSON format.

methods.description: General function to extract a SET from JSON, handling optional presence, and supporting both array formats and single values, for various data types.
